questions.explanation: Can you lend me $10? = Can I borrow $10 from you?
pay FOR something; spend money ON something.
Kiyim: What size? It doesn't fit. Too tight/loose.
Maqtab aytish uchun: good value yoki affordable.
Can I have a receipt? — chek so'rash.
I→me, he→him, she→her, we→us, they→them; you/it o'zgarmaydi.
Predlogdan keyin DOIM object olmoshi: with me, for him, to us.

options: Narsa olmosh bo'lsa: Give it to me
questions.explanation: give/send/tell/show → to; buy/make/get → for.
Predlogdan keyin object: between you and me (and I emas).
Ega o'rnida — John and I; to'ldiruvchi o'rnida — John and me.

options: mustn't — TA'QIQ; don't have to — shart emas (erkin)
questions.explanation: Bu ikkisi TESKARI ma'no beradi — A2 ning eng muhim farqi.
must ning o'tmishi yo'q → had to; kelajak → will have to.
ought to = should. Kuchliroq maslahat: had better ('d better).
have to oddiy fe'l kabi do/does oladi; must esa modal.
have to = «hafta», mustn't = «masnt».

questions.text: «I want you ___ help me» — bo'shliqqa nima?
questions.explanation: want + KIM + to + V1. «want that you help» — xato.
would like + to + V1. «I'd like go» — xato.
So'rov/buyurtma → would like; orzu yoki do'st bilan → want.

questions.text: «Would you like...?» va «Do you like...?» qanday farqlanadi?
options: Would you like — HOZIR taklif; Do you like — UMUMAN yoqtirish
questions.explanation: Would you like some tea? (hozir) ≠ Do you like tea? (umuman).

questions.text: Restoranda buyurtma berish uchun qaysi ibora ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: I'll have the soup, please. Yoki: I'd like the soup.
because it rained ↔ because of the rain.

questions.text: «Although it was raining, but we went» — bu nega xato?
questions.explanation: Bittasini tanlang: Although it was raining, we went. YOKI: It was raining, but we went.
It rained, so we stayed = We stayed because it rained. Ikkalasini birga ishlatmang.
also — fe'l oldida; too / as well — gap oxirida.

options: but ning rasmiy varianti — alohida gapda
questions.explanation: Yozma va rasmiy uslubda ishlatiladi.
give up = taslim bo'lmoq — «give» va «up» ma'nosidan chiqmaydi.

questions.text: «turn on the TV» da olmosh ishlatilsa qanday bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: Ajraladigan phrasal verbda OLMOSH doim o'rtada turadi.
look after them (look them after — xato).

questions.text: «get up, sit down, break down» — qaysi turga kiradi?
questions.explanation: Bu fe'llar to'ldiruvchisiz ishlatiladi.
Urg'u odatda zarrachada: get UP, turn it ON.
Maxsus shakllar: good→well, fast→fast, hard→hard, late→late.
-y → -ily; -le → -ly (gently); -ic → -ally (basically).
Tuzoq juftliklar: hardly ≠ hard; lately (so'nggi paytda) ≠ late.

questions.text: «He speaks fluently English» — bu nega xato?
options: Ravish object dan KEYIN turadi: speaks English fluently
questions.explanation: Ravish fe'l va to'ldiruvchi orasiga kirmaydi.
Sezgi fe'llari (look/feel/smell/taste/sound) SIFAT oladi, ravish emas.
